title: Rooms Keys Key-Package — payload
description: An invited party asks the agent that will hold its room keys for the MLS KeyPackage the room's owner adds to the group: the one it already holds for this room, member and invitation, or a new one. The private half stays with the agent; only the KeyPackage travels.

roomId.description: The room to mint a KeyPackage for. Scoped per room rather than reused across rooms: one KeyPackage presented to two rooms correlates a member across them, which is the linkage a `private` room exists to deny.

invitation.description: The invitation credential (VIC) the room issued to the member, serialized per the governing profile. It authorizes the mint, names the member — its subject — and, with the room and the member, identifies the KeyPackage the recipient returns again while it is outstanding.

keyPackage.description: The MLS KeyPackage, base64url. Public: it carries a signature key, an HPKE init key and the leaf's credential, and nothing that opens anything.

expiresAt.description: When the recipient stops holding the KeyPackage's private half. The same instant on every answer that returns the same KeyPackage: returning it again does not extend it.

alreadyMinted.description: `true` when the recipient returned a KeyPackage it had already minted for this room, member and invitation and still holds; `false` when it minted this one for this request.
